text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: My name is—Daring Tact.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A horsegirl I met deep in the rugged 
mountains 
of the Hidaka subprefecture in 
Hokkaido—Daring Tact.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Loved by the locals and raised freely 
amidst rich nature... before she knew it, 
a great "dream" had begun to swell within 
her heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If I, raised by Hidaka, keep winning in 
the Twinkle Series... 
then that will be a victory for Hidaka 
itself. 
I can prove just how wonderful my hometown 
is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Drawn to her inner strength and her 
racing, 
honed by nature and brimming with 
potential—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please. 
Won't you make me... 
a horsegirl who goes down in history?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that she had successfully enrolled at 
Tracen Academy, 
I signed a contract to become her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text:
—And this is the gym, available to any 
Tracen Academy student. 
It's equipped with state-of-the-art 
machines.

text_block_list.name: New Students
text_block_list.text:
"Wooow!" "That one's super expensive...!" 
"There are so many of the same 
machine...!" 
"H-How are you even supposed to use 
this..."
choice_data_list: Let's give them a try, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
choice_data_list:
This one automatically tracks your 
resistance and—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Automatic tracking... 
Incredible...

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text:
This cafeteria is used by horsegirls, 
staff, 
and trainers alike. With a few exceptions, 
everything is completely free at 
lunchtime!

text_block_list.name: New Students
text_block_list.text:
"F-Free?!" "So generous!" 
"Ooh, it's buffet-style!" 
"They even have protein drinks... As 
expected!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So many carrot dishes... Hehe. 
I suppose that's natural when it's all 
horsegirls.

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text:
Some of you may have seen this during open 
campus 
or the Fan Appreciation Festival, but here 
you can also rehearse for Winning Lives.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Even a stage...!

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text: —And lastly, here is the training track.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Whoa...!

text_block_list.name: New Students
text_block_list.text:
"It's huuuuge...!" "As big as a real 
racetrack!" 
"No fighting over space here~" 
"—Ah... are they running a mock race over 
there?"

text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact gazed at the horsegirls racing 
with all their might, 
competing fiercely against each other, 
with a serious... and highly anticipatory 
look in her eyes.
choice_data_list:
Really makes it sink in that you're 
enrolled, doesn't it?

Really makes it sink in that you're 
enrolled, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
At this academy... 
I can truly walk the path of racing.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Together with you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it our all!
Yeah, let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Once again, 
I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: New Student A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, seriously?! That person's 
your trainer, Daring Tact?!

text_block_list.name: New Student B
text_block_list.text:
No way, you already have a trainer?! 
That's insane! What training club did you 
come from anyway?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ah... Well, I'm—

text_block_list.name: New Student C
text_block_list.text:
Like, can't we get into the deep stuff 
after school? 
Daring Tact, right? We're totally hyping 
this up later, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Eh, ah, umm...?
choice_data_list:
It's okay, why not take them up on the 
invitation?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...You're right!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the invitation. 
So, after school... whose room 
should I come over to?

text_block_list.name: New Student C
text_block_list.text:
Wait, straight to a room? Not a cafe by 
the station or something? 
...Well, jumping right into being close 
works too, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: There's... a cafe?!
choice_data_list:
(...Maybe I should show her around town 
sometime.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact had only just arrived from 
Hidaka. 
Life in Tokyo seemed to be full 
of brand-new experiences for her—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Whoa... It's a train station!
choice_data_list:
Surely you have stations in Hokkaido too, 
don't you?

Surely you have stations in Hokkaido too, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes... but where I'm from, 
some of the train lines have been 
discontinued, so—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Shoot, I'm gonna be late! 
Next one's in 5 minutes... Gotta make that 
train...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...In five minutes? 
............Every five minutes...?!
choice_data_list: (She's completely blown away...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Didn't we see 
this exact same cafe just a moment ago...?
choice_data_list:
Ah, they have several locations around 
here.

Yeah, they have several locations around 
here.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
What?! Why are they so close together? 
Wouldn't they just end up competing for 
the same customers...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...And no matter how far we walk, there's 
not a single field in sight. 
The city truly is... extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And inside the academy, as well—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? 
Isn't the gym this way...?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"A-Again, back on this floor... 
Why are there so many stairs...?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"—I'm so sorry I'm late...! 
*huff*... *pant*..."
choice_data_list: A-Are you all right?
A-Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry, I ended up getting lost... 
Tracen Academy really is enormous...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Still, thanks to all that walking, I'm 
completely warmed up. 
Ready when you are, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: *huff*... H-Heavy...!

text_block_list.name: Tough-Looking Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
"*pant*... *pant*... 
Phew... Guess I'll up the weight."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible. She's lifting that with 
ease...

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
"—My trainer told me about it earlier! 
You induce strong muscle contractions 
beforehand to temporarily 
boost your initial rate of force 
development!"

text_block_list.name: Earnest Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, PAP! Or rather, PAPE! 
Right, Post-Activation Performance 
Enhancement—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Those are upperclassmen, right? 
What they're talking about sounds so 
incredibly advanced..."
choice_data_list:
Well, they did make it into Tracen 
Academy, after all.

Well, they did earn their place here at 
Tracen Academy, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right. This is the caliber 
of the premier horsegirl training academy 
in Japan..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I have to give it my all and keep up 
with them!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"(Finally, a day off... Lately, between 
studying 
and training... time has just flown by in 
a blur. 
I haven't had a single moment to catch my 
breath.)"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"(...Still, I really should do some solo 
training. 
I need to get used to the pace here as 
fast as I can.)"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Just a little break first, though...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: *inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Ahhh... To think even the big city 
has places as peaceful as this."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Looks like fishing is permitted here. 
Maybe I'll catch my lunch right on the 
spot."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"(Mask my presence... bide my time. 
Once an off-guard fish wanders close, 
a single thrust...—!)"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "(CLANG!! Clatter, clatter...)"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A fair amount of time had passed since 
Daring Tact enrolled. 
Today, I came with important news for her. 
And that was—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (*knock, knock*)
choice_data_list: Come in!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Hi, Trainer! 
How are you?"
choice_data_list: Wait, you're Daring... Heart!?
Wait, are you Daring... Heart!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yep! 
Nice to meet you ♡

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is Daring Heart. 
An American-raised horsegirl with an 
impressive record, 
boasting three graded stakes victories in 
the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Daring Heart...! 
You certainly move fast...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, sorry about that! I got so excited 
at the thought of meeting your trainer, my 
feet just took off on their own♪"
choice_data_list: Um, how do you two know each other...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"How do we... Well. 
If I had to put it in words, we're... 
'survival buddies.'"
choice_data_list: Survival buddies?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! 
We were on the exact same mountain, aiming 
for the exact same fish, with pretty much 
the exact same spears!"
choice_data_list: ...Spears!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. As we got to talking... 
we discovered we share a mutual love 
for survival living."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"And we've been 
close ever since."
choice_data_list: I see...
Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I had plenty of questions, but deep down, 
I felt relieved. 
Having a dependable senior at the academy 
to rely on 
was an incredible blessing for Daring 
Tact.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"All right, I'm satisfied now! 
I only meant to drop by and say hello. 
I'll be taking off, then."
choice_data_list:
...Actually, maybe you should stick around 
and hear this too.

...Wait, maybe you'd like to hear this 
too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Oh... that's right! Trainer, 
what was that important news you 
mentioned...?"
choice_data_list: Your debut date has been decided, Tact!
Your debut date is officially set, Tact!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! Congrats, Tact! 
You did it!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much...! 
I'm really... going to debut!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"To finally step into the Twinkle 
Series... 
Me, too...!"
choice_data_list: Let's kick our training into high gear!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes...! 
I'll do my very best, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text:
""Whoaaaa...!"" ""Your debut's finally 
here!"" 
""Congratulations, Tact-chaaan!""

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe... 
Thank you, everyone."

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
"We'll get to see our Tact on TV from now 
on! 
Oh, we're just so happy for you!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Please, keep watching over me. 
You've all done so, so much for me, 
after all..."

text_block_list.name: Gentle Man
text_block_list.text:
"Tact-chaaan! Hey, over here! 
—Ta-da! Your very own personal course!"

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Whoaaa...! Wow, wow, wow! 
It goes all the way aroooound! 
It's just like the ones on TV...!"

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it's far from the real deal, of 
course! 
But we all did a bunch of research and 
built it together, so it oughta feel just 
like a real race!"

text_block_list.name: Kind Woman
text_block_list.text:
"We can't run alongside you as pacing 
partners, but... 
if there's anything else we can do to 
help, just say the word. We've got plenty 
of potato mochi, too."

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...! Potato mochi, too?! 
I love you guys sooo much!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to make everyone proud. 
As a horsegirl born and raised in Hidaka—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I will make my mark on history!
